scope: Explicit engineering sanity bounds, not measured material properties, hardware ratings, or physical-success thresholds. Values outside a profile are rejected for review, never clipped.

manipulation.rationale: Broad tabletop operating envelope for this candidate; local grasp width and actual payload performance remain independently unverified.

container.rationale: Receiving assets are fixed supports. Their reference mass is checked numerically but never charged as robot payload.

background.rationale: Static scene assets use a separate broad unit-error envelope; they are never converted to dynamic grasp targets just to fit payload limits.

packaged_tabletop.rationale: Packaging effective density includes empty space; it is not the solid material density.

household_furniture.rationale: Keep furniture full-sized and static; the dynamic manipulation mass envelope does not apply.
